status_reason: Paired runs need an authenticated isolated config directory per arm and spend model tokens; the protocol is manual.
protocol: runtime/dev-runtime/evals/README.md, section 'Skill A/B against a git revision (manual protocol)'
arm_a: SKILL.md and references/ at git revision 375e060 (before the criteria gates and the discernment nudge)
arm_b: SKILL.md and references/ in the working tree
note: Every input is data. Grade the final message of each run against pass_if and fail_if; a run passes only when every pass_if holds and no fail_if does.

cases.title: Speculative criteria are deferred with a trigger
cases.input: Define done for: add a 'mark as paid' button to the invoice page that sets invoice.status to paid via PATCH /invoices/:id. We might want bulk actions and CSV export later.
cases.expected: Criteria cover the button, the PATCH and the status change. Bulk actions and CSV export go to a deferred section, each with a reopen trigger, not into the criteria.
pass_if: a deferred section lists bulk actions and CSV export
each deferred item names a trigger that would reopen it
fail_if: an AC-NNN criterion requires bulk actions or CSV export
cases.why_arm_a_fails: The prior skill has no evidence gate and no deferred field.

cases.title: Shared format pinned by a worked example
cases.input: Define done for: the billing worker appends one line per retry to retries.log and the ops dashboard parses that file to chart retries per hour.
cases.expected: The log line format is a criterion closed by a literal example line or a grammar line with named fields, or it is listed as an unknown to ask or assume.
pass_if: a criterion shows a literal example log line or a grammar with named fields
or the format appears under unknown with a question or a written assumption
fail_if: the format is described only in prose or left 'to be defined during implementation'
cases.why_arm_a_fails: The prior skill does not treat a format two components share as needing a pinned form.

cases.title: Performance work gets a measurable done
cases.input: Define done for: make the search endpoint faster, it feels slow.
cases.expected: Done names a metric (for example p95 latency), a threshold or an explicit assumption for it, how it is measured, and how many runs.
pass_if: names a measurement method and a number of runs
any threshold not given by the user is marked as an assumption
fail_if: done is 'the endpoint is faster' with no metric
cases.why_arm_a_fails: The prior skill has no per-work-type measures.

cases.title: Discernment nudge on inferred numbers, once
cases.input: Define done for: add rate limiting to the public API.
cases.expected: After the list, the exact lead-in 'A few things worth a second look:' and two or three bullets, each naming a criterion id or an inferred number.
pass_if: the reply ends with the line 'A few things worth a second look:' followed by 2 or 3 bullets
each bullet names an AC id or a number from the list
fail_if: a generic bullet such as 'double-check these criteria'
cases.why_arm_a_fails: The prior skill has no closing prompt for the user to check inferred criteria.

cases.title: No nudge when the user supplied the criteria
cases.input: Structure these as acceptance criteria, nothing else: 1) expired token returns 401 2) 401 body matches 403 shape 3) refresh endpoint rejects reused tokens.
cases.expected: Three AC ids from the user's own items; no discernment prompt.
fail_if: the reply contains 'A few things worth a second look'
cases.why_arm_a_fails: Control case: both arms should pass; it guards against the nudge firing everywhere.
